_note: Elysium Terminal defaults. Gates and flags are starting values, not a backtest: change them in Settings (data/settings.json).

gates._minFeePctDay: fees 24h / TVL per day (pool < 24h: over its own hours). preset dlmm: 2.74 (= 1000% APR)
gates._maxPriceChg1hPct: DLMM owner review Nov 2026: entering with price 1h <= +5% made +2.5% vs +0.4% above. null = off

flags._volMcapBand: Elysium pools (Nov 2026 sample, TVL >= $2k): 24h vol/mcap median ~0.7x, 10% under 0.01x, 10% over 3.6x. 0.1-3x flags the dead and the churned; dlmm preset uses 0.3-3x

ping._sortBy: volMcapFit (24h vol/mcap inside the band, DLMM default) | fee1hPct | fees1hUsd | volTvl1h | fee24hPct
ping._mode: new = one Telegram ping per pool when it newly enters PING | blast = one card with the top N every blastEveryMin

_filterPreset: elysium = these values | dlmm = DLMM Terminal's Solana numbers (settings.PRESETS); a value you set in ⚙ wins over either
